item.description: Democratic socialists had their best showing yet at the polls. The problem: Most U.S. voters don't actually like socialism.

item.description: A bout of hard selling battered the stock market Thursday, sending the three major averages to their worst session since April 2025.

item.title: Anthropic’s breakneck rise: What to know before the IPO
item.description: Anthropic began its journey as an under-the-radar research lab founded in 2021 by seven former OpenAI employees. Now, the company is poised to launch an historic public debut that could set the tone for the AI trade in 2027 and test investors’ appetite for an entirely new asset class. CNBC explores Anthropic’s rapid rise, its rivalry with OpenAI and its clash with the Pentagon, and what its public debut could mean for the AI trade.

item.title: Microsoft plans to use fewer neoclouds as AI buildout shows signs of strain
item.description: Microsoft is winding down the number of neoclouds it counts as partners, picking key suppliers and focusing on its own data centers.

item.title: Data center double-down: Hassett says blue wave won't stop AI build-out
item.description: Data centers are a crucial part of President Donald Trump's push to win the global artificial intelligence race, which he continues despite the midterm results.

item.title: Jay Rockefeller, heir to famed dynasty and healthcare advocate in U.S. Senate, dies at 89
item.description: John D. "Jay" Rockefeller IV, the progeny of one of America's most famous and wealthiest families, died on Friday at his home in Washington. He was 89.

item.title: Investors brace for lower Anthropic valuation, calling $1.5 trillion a 'stretch'
item.description: Anthropic could list below a $1.5 trillion valuation, trailing previous expectations, as the AI trade sours on Wall Street.
